data.title: Golf Vista Heights
data.about:
Experience the pinnacle of luxury living at Golf Vista Heights, a prestigious development by London Gate, situated in the vibrant heart of Dubai Sports City. Each morning, awaken to the mesmerizing views of a pristine golf course, a view that sets a tranquil tone for your day. Golf Vista Heights by London Gate offers not just homes, but private terraces that overlook the sweeping vistas of lush greenery, creating a sanctuary of peace and elegance. This is more than a residence—it's a lifestyle choice where every second is valued, and every scenery is a breathtaking masterpiece.

Golf Vista Heights stands as a beacon of tranquility within the bustling Dubai Sports City, offering a harmonious blend of calm and luxury. This family-centric community is your gateway to the captivating views of the golf course, providing a sumptuous retreat that transcends the norms of everyday living.

With a grand total of 209 units spread over B+G+14 floors, Golf Vista Heights floorplans showcases modern architecture at its finest. This collection includes 73 studio apartments, 91 one-bedroom units with options for open or closed kitchens, 43 two-bedroom apartments tailored with various kitchen designs, and 2 three-bedroom units featuring exclusive kitchens. Each home in Golf Vista Heights is a masterpiece of design, boasting floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the magnificent views, alongside creatively crafted built-in wardrobes and elegant ensuite bathrooms. Dive into the luxurious lifestyle offered at Golf Vista Heights for sale, now available in Dubai Sports City, and elevate your living experience.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in the pulsating heart of Dubai, Dubai Sports City is a testament to an active, sports-centered lifestyle, with Golf Vista Heights by London Gate standing as a crown jewel within this vibrant community. This thoughtfully designed neighborhood is a haven for athletes, sports enthusiasts, and anyone seeking an energetic lifestyle, right in the midst of Golf Vista Heights Dubai Sports City.

Golf Vista Heights, developed by London Gate, is surrounded by world-class sports facilities, including the prestigious Dubai International Stadium and the Els Club golf course. This prime location offers residents and guests of Golf Vista Heights unparalleled access to a myriad of sports and recreational activities, catering to both professional athletes and amateurs.

The strategic placement of Dubai Sports City, and by extension Golf Vista Heights, ensures easy navigation to Dubai’s bustling attractions, business hubs, and educational institutions.
